inferred_act_reading: W1 reading of INFERRED ACT: a fact is INFERRED ACT when it asserts that a begetting or a knowing took place, who did it, or that a word names one, and the quoted verse words do not say it. A fact that a begetting or knowing did NOT take place (sole parent, apart from the husband, sets the father aside, her state continued) is not an act; it is labeled STATED or NOT STATED. A fact about word sense, cause, house, lineage or time is labeled STATED or NOT STATED.
